operator-2026-08-02.note: 245 measured frames, windows taken as the p2/p98 of the range the operator actually showed. Saturation fell from 47% to 4%. Only the thumb windows were measured; CURL_OPEN and CURL_CLOSED are deliberately absent so the module defaults stand. Choosing the metric mattered as much as the numbers: the first attempt maximised how much of the travel was reachable (94%, which looked excellent) and that hid the real problem - saturation is what tells you the operator's hand is moving and the robot's is not.
